lang_app_lead: Automatically imports IP block lists into the DSM IP block list.
lang_howto_body: The AutoBan package wraps the script update_blocklist.sh with a user interface, a schedule, and a small setuid helper. AutoBan updates and imports blocked IPs from blocklist.de into the IP block list of Synology DSM.
lang_help_support: Downloads settings, the DSM block list database, the log, other package logs, and the DSM package log as a ZIP file.
lang_backup_confirm: Restore this backup? The current system database will be replaced.
lang_clear_confirm: Delete all blocked addresses from the DSM block list? Allow entries are kept.
lang_help_interval:
How often the automatic import starts while the schedule is on.
blocklist.de updates the list every 30 minutes.
lang_help_blocklist_typ: List from blocklist.de. While the list URL still points to lists.blocklist.de, it is updated when you change this.
lang_help_import_ipv6: Imports IPv6 addresses from the list. Off leaves them out. Addresses already in the block list stay.
lang_help_source_url: Address of the main list. The default is the selected blocklist.de list.
lang_help_extra_sources: Further lists, one http or https address per line. A failed extra source does not abort the run.
lang_help_delete_after:
Imported addresses are removed after this many days.
0: keep them permanently.
lang_help_loglevel:
0: errors only.
1: brief info.
2: details as well.
lang_help_scheduler: Turns the automatic import on. Off means no source is queried until the schedule is on again or you choose Run now.
lang_help_geoip_mode:
off: no GeoIP filter, all addresses are imported.
blockonly: only addresses from the named countries are kept.
blockother: addresses from the named countries are left out, all others are kept.
lang_help_geoip_countries: ISO country codes used by the GeoIP filter.
lang_help_geoip_db: Path to the MaxMind GeoLite2-City file.
lang_help_max_attempts: How many times the main list is downloaded before the run counts as failed.
lang_help_fail_alert: A DSM notification appears after this many failed attempts in a row.
lang_help_recovery_alert: The all-clear appears after this many successful runs.
lang_help_notify_lang: Language of the DSM notification. It applies only to the notification, not to the interface.
lang_help_deny:
Block list: addresses are stored as blocked.
Allow list: addresses are stored as allowed.
lang_help_meta: Only for a range or netmask, for example the mask.
lang_help_progress: Progress display only when the script is run directly as root.
lang_help_debug: Writes one line with the runtime to var/perf/last.ndjson.
lang_legacy_task: Task Scheduler still has an active task that runs the old update_blocklist.sh script. You should disable or delete it. Open Control Panel → Task Scheduler. The task name is {name}.
lang_legacy_tasks: Task Scheduler still has active tasks that run the old update_blocklist.sh script. You should disable or delete them. Open Control Panel → Task Scheduler. The task names are {name}.
lang_works_sorry: Sorry it is not working. A note on GitHub helps.
